caption:
Tesla's self-driving software caught a highway crash about to happen and avoided it before the driver could react. The clip shows all the angles of the same moment, with the AI's detection data running at the top of the screen.

This is V14 of Full Self-Driving, supervised mode, which reads multiple camera feeds at once and makes braking and steering calls faster than any human reflex. The driver was still in the seat. The car made the move.
